description: Airports of Laos is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ADB. Airport locations in Laos including attributes (name, type ICAO and IATA code). Coverage: Lao People's Democratic Republic. The portal files it under the publisher ADB. Its tags are Airports and air travel, Transport infrastructure and facilities. It offers 4 resource(s) in db_table, wms, zip. The portal shows 2019-10-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
